_about: Pre-registered stock-phrase lexicon for the Ep01 study, v0.1, 30 Oct 2026. FREEZE this file before the main run: once main-run outputs exist, changes go into a new version and are reported as post hoc. Each pattern is a case-insensitive regex with word boundaries added by the analysis. Every pattern belongs to exactly one category, so totals are a union with no double counting. Categories: author = the author's own habitual business phrases; ai_literature = words shown to be over-used by LLMs in published studies (Kobak et al. 2025, Yakura et al. 2026; see _research/_source_check_v0.1.md); business = common business stock phrases; ai_practitioner = commonly cited 'AI tells' from practitioner lists, which are UNSOURCED and reported separately as secondary. Before freezing, 'unlock … potential' moved from business to author, after the author confirmed on 30 Oct 2026 that it is one of their own habitual phrases (decisions Q5).
